tools.name: tyi_discover
tools.description: Call first. Shows available chains, LLM providers, and money tools so you know what to pass to tyi_onboard.

tools.name: tyi_onboard
tools.description: One-shot TYI setup: local wallet, agent auth, session, LLM key, policy, wallet bind. Call before tyi_run.

agentName.description: What to call this agent in Tychi (your choice, e.g. Trading Bot)

chainId.description: Which network this wallet connects to. Today use 10143 (Monad testnet). Set once at setup not needed on every message.

llmProvider.description: Which AI model provider runs the agent brain: openai, anthropic, groq, etc. Optional if TYI_LLM_PROVIDER is in env.

policyMode.description: read_only = agent can look (balance, portfolio) but not send money. execute = agent can spend, within limits you set.

maxPerTxUsd.description: Max dollars the agent may spend in one transaction. Only used when policyMode is execute. Default 25.

actions.description: Which money tools the agent may use, e.g. get_portfolio, transfer_native, create_token. Leave empty to let server defaults apply.

tools.name: tyi_run
tools.description: Send a message to your TYI agent. Use after tyi_onboard.

message.description: What you want the agent to do

tools.name: tyi_resume_tx
tools.description: Sign and broadcast a pending transaction after tyi_run returned pending tx.

run_id.description: From tyi_run response; uses last run if omitted

tools.name: tyi_resume_x402
tools.description: Sign x402 payment and resume agent after tyi_run returned pending x402.

run_id.description: From tyi_run; uses last run if omitted
